company_name: Fukuoka Industry, Science and Technology Foundation,Fukuoka Semiconductor Reskillin
semiconductor_relevance: Medium - The company focuses on reskilling personnel in the semiconductor industry, which supports the workforce development aspect of the semiconductor value chain.
summary: The Fukuoka Semiconductor Reskilling Center provides training courses aimed at cultivating skilled personnel in semiconductor and digital technologies. Their programs cover fundamental concepts and technical skills necessary for various roles in semiconductor manufacturing, including equipment and process engineering.

regional_presence.Japan: The center aims to support personnel development specifically in Fukuoka Prefecture and throughout Japan.
